verdict:
WATCH - no entry, but the 9/10 KILL does not survive, and the reason it does not survive is that our own red bench built a valuation roof by hand while the issuer had already published the second point of the curve.

WHAT RED GOT WRONG, VERIFIED AT THE PRIMARY. Red's strongest single kill was an SLI-class inversion: 'at Blue Moon's own feasibility economics a fully-funded, fully-permitted Nussir plus all corporate cash is worth $3.43/share against a $4.82 tape - cure doesn't matter, the roof is below the ladder.' That rests on the consensus deck alone. The same press release discloses a spot case at $559M NPV8 / 31.2% IRR, and I confirmed it verbatim. On the corrected share count (~105.2M implied by the $506.95M cap at $4.82, not the 98.43M weighted average red divided by) the funded prize is ~$3.21/share at consensus and ~$6.29/share at the study's spot deck. Red's roof is one of two roofs, and the tape sits between them - which is a coherent price for partial spot persistence times partial permit cure, not an inverted roof.

AND THE COPPER PRICE MATTERS MORE THAN EITHER BENCH ALLOWED. LME cash copper settled $14,545/t on 14 August and $14,850/t on 17 August - $6.60 and $6.74 per pound - against the study's spot deck of $5.84/lb and its long-term consensus deck of $4.78/lb. Red's finding that bulls were quoting a tariff-inflated COMEX print is refuted by the LME series itself. Applied to the disclosed anchor pair, the funded, cured project at today's metal prices is worth materially ABOVE the tape, not below it. Cure is worth roughly the whole equity, which is the opposite of red's framing.

WHY THIS IS STILL NOT AN ENTRY. Three separate things must go right, and one predictable thing must happen first. (a) ESA infringement Case 86194 is live and its operative conclusion names Repparfjorden indre and ytre; the June-2026 Norwegian approvals are probably not a re-validation, because the Ministry's own 23-Jan-2024 doctrine (quoted at ESA p.22) says a non-deteriorating amendment does not trigger a fresh Article 4(7) assessment, and ESA expressly held the EU CRMA Strategic Project designation does not alter its findings. (b) The precious-metals stream is NOT closed - the issuer's own 13-Aug release says so verbatim - leaving a gap of at least ~US$70M against US$184M of initial capex, and the stream sells the gold and silver legs, which at spot are ~26% of revenue rather than the ~19% at consensus. Signing it at MOU-era terms transfers exactly the leg that makes the spot deck work. (c) Weighted-average shares went 51.3M to 98.4M in five quarters and the equity gap has to be financed. Per the value-ladder flow gate, we do not bid into a dilutive flow we ourselves predict.

WHERE OUR OWN BENCHES ERRED, BEYOND THE ARTIFACT. Red counted crowding (Scotiabank C$14, Maxim $15, a Viceroy short report, a fresh 13G/A) as a kill-supporting finding. Per DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE that is backwards: two published targets and a short report mean this name has EXTERNAL anchors we can be graded against, which is what makes an edge claim gradeable at all. The work owed is to state what copper deck and what p(cure) those targets embed against ours - nobody did it. Second, the runner allowed two blue benches on one red case; they contradicted each other on a checkable price and the queue carried both. Third, note 22 (subsequent events) in the 2026-08-13 6-K went unread by every bench and could contain stream or bridge developments.

THE GATE MUST BE CONDITIONED (beta-carrier rule, 2026-08-18). The ledger currently arms alert_below $3.21 - the consensus-deck funded value. On a pre-revenue single-asset copper developer the equity is a levered call on the copper price: $3.21 arrives overwhelmingly because copper fell, and a copper collapse lowers the funded prize by more than it lowers the tape. That gate fires when the thesis is worse, not cheaper. It must be re-specified as review-only and paired with a carrier condition and an event condition before it can carry any action.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED - and this name was tried by TWO blue benches (202608170100 and 202608170103) that reached contradictory rulings on the same price fact, which is itself the process finding. Both blues overturned red's FATAL prize-table inversion by pointing at a second NPV case disclosed in the issuer's own feasibility PR; blue-1 then SUSTAINED red's COMEX-vs-LME basis kill (LME quoted at $6.08/lb), while blue-2 OVERTURNED it (LME cash 14-Aug at $14,545/t = $6.60/lb, calling red's metalradar forward quote stale/mislabelled). I re-fetched both primaries per BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED. (1) The feasibility PR does disclose the dual deck verbatim: after-tax NPV8 $235M / 19% IRR at the consensus deck (LT $4.78/lb Cu, $3,515/oz Au, $45.26/oz Ag) AND after-tax NPV8 $559M / 31.2% IRR at 4-Mar-2026 spot ($5.84/lb Cu, $5,171/oz Au, $84.61/oz Ag), initial capex $184M, payable mix 77% Cu / 6% Au / 13% Ag at consensus. Red's 'the FS press release omits any sensitivity table' is true only in the narrow sense that there is no formal matrix - the second anchor point existed and red built a desk slope instead. Blue's overturn PASSES. (2) LME copper cash settlements from westmetall: 13-Aug $14,285/t, 14-Aug $14,545/t (= $6.60/lb), 17-Aug $14,850/t (= $6.74/lb); 4-Mar-2026 was $12,960/t (= $5.88/lb). Blue-2 PASSES and blue-1 FAILS: the $6.60 the bulls quote is LME cash itself, not a COMEX tariff premium, and today's LME cash sits ABOVE the study's own spot deck. Red's kg_candidate comex_lme_realization_basis encodes red's data error and must not be harvested as evidenced.
reopen_gates: PRICE, CONDITIONED (replaces the bare alert_below 3.21 - beta-carrier self-trigger): review-only alert at <= $3.60. ACTIONABLE only if BOTH (i) LME copper cash >= $5.50/lb at the time of the fill, so the discount is idiosyncratic rather than carrier-driven, AND (ii) at least one of the ESA or financing branches below has resolved favourably. A fill at $3.21 on a copper break is the funded prize shrinking, not a cheaper option on it.

EVENT (financing, undated): the precious-metals stream closing on published terms. Accretive test, stated in advance: upfront >= US$80-100M for <= 20% of payable precious metals with >= 25% ongoing spot pricing. Read the per-ounce percentage against $84/oz silver, not against the MOU-era deck - at spot the Au+Ag leg is ~26% of LOM revenue, so a cheap stream is the bull case being sold.

EVENT (legal, undated): ESA Case 86194 closure, or a Norwegian Royal Decree performing the Article 4(7)(c) scarcity/uses/purposes reasoning ex ante (ESA's own letter signposts the cure at p.25), or conversely a Reasoned Opinion escalating. Either direction re-courts the name; a Reasoned Opinion against Norway with construction capex still entering the ground is the stranded-capex tail arriving.

DATA (owed before any re-court): read note 22 subsequent events in the 2026-08-13 6-K (unread by all three benches), pull the Nov-25/Jan-26 placement lockup terms (lockup_expiration_calendar was UNCHECKABLE both benches, and a 13G/A landed 08-14), and baseline sentinel2_buildout on the Kvalsund parcel - construction pace is the one physical read that conditions the stranded-capex downside and it is currently unmeasured.

DIVERGENCE (owed before any bid): state what copper deck and what p(cure) the published targets (Scotiabank C$14, Maxim $15) embed, against ours. Two sell-side anchors on a single-asset developer are a gift under the mispricing-artifact taxonomy - they make our number gradeable instead of circular.
DATA (unit discipline): all gates are US$ on the Nasdaq line. The widely-quoted 'fell 11% to $6.85' figures are C$ on TSXV:MOON. Any alert must be stamped with its venue and currency.
process_findings: HELD STATUS: NOT HELD. Ledger row exists (WATCH, court_gates, alert_below 3.21, 'deck-provisional gate pending adjudication'). THIS DRAFT CHANGES THAT GATE: 3.21 -> review-only 3.60 with a copper-carrier condition attached. Do not leave a bare price alert armed on a levered single-commodity developer.

BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: two blue corrections re-fetched. The dual-deck NPV correction PASSES verbatim at the issuer PR. The LME/COMEX correction splits the twins - blue-2 PASSES against the westmetall LME cash series, blue-1 FAILS. Red's kg candidate is rejected as evidenced.

DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE: red used two-sided crowding (analyst initiations plus a Viceroy short) as a kill-supporting finding. Re-based: crowding conditions SIZE and TIMING here (both tails are fat and a squeeze is live on any ESA closure), and the published targets are external anchors we owe a stated divergence against, not evidence of no edge.

PROCESS DEFECT (validator-grade): two COURT_BLUE artifacts for one red case, contradicting each other on a checkable price fact. The runner must not dispatch a duplicate bench without marking the case unreconciled; see the duplicate_bench_contradiction_unreconciled candidate.

SCREEN DEFECT (upstream, worth wiring): the blob_sweep row carries an empty sector, so excess_dd == dd52 by construction and the 'cohort' is degenerate at n=1. This name reached triage as a dispersion signal that contained no dispersion information.
SHARE COUNT: per-share work must use ~105.2M implied shares outstanding (cap / price), not the 98.43M Q2 weighted average. Red priced the prize table on the weighted average and understated dilution.

PRINT CLOCK: no print within 5 trading days of 2026-08-17/18; Q2 interims already landed 2026-08-13. The live catalysts are administrative and undated, which is why the pack is tier B and the gates are event-shaped.
TAX: no distribution; pre-revenue developer, all return is capital gain. Nothing load-bearing on after-tax carry.

PRIZE-TABLE MANDATE (SLI, 2026-08-14): satisfied - the magic-funding counterfactual exists and is now anchored to the issuer's disclosed pair rather than a desk slope. Entry logic on this name is JOINT by construction: copper-deck threshold AND a funding/legal milestone, never funding alone.

kg_candidates.name: fs_disclosed_sensitivity_anchor
kg_candidates.source: blue bench (BMM, 202608170103); adjudicator verified the disclosed anchor pair at the primary PR
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - this is the batch's clearest III-precedent repeat: the killer fact was the bench's own artifact. Merge blue-1's issuer_dual_deck_ignored into this one; they are the same rule stated twice.
kg_candidates.one_line: Any desk-computed NPV price-sensitivity must be anchored to the study's own disclosed multi-point NPVs (consensus deck plus spot case); a hand-built slope that contradicts the disclosed pair is an artifact and must not carry a verdict.
kg_candidates.fires_on: a pre-revenue developer court where a bench computes a per-unit-price NPV sensitivity while the technical-study PR or NI 43-101/JORC summary discloses two or more NPV points; test = does the bench's slope reproduce the disclosed pair?
kg_candidates.evidence_here: BMM: red built ~$180M NPV per $1/lb copper (copper-only) and concluded the funded prize was below the tape. The FS PR discloses NPV8 $235M at LT $4.78/lb and NPV8 $559M at 4-Mar-2026 spot $5.84/lb with Au $5,171 and Ag $84.61 - an implied ~$295M per $1/lb once by-product torque is included, which flips the funded prize from ~30% below the tape to ~30% above it.

kg_candidates.name: comex_lme_realization_basis
kg_candidates.disposition: REJECT AS EVIDENCED - the underlying idea (non-US producers realise LME/European terms, so COMEX quotes carry a tariff premium) is sound in general, but the instance encodes red's own data error: I fetched the LME cash series and 14-Aug settled $14,545/t = $6.60/lb, 17-Aug $14,850/t = $6.74/lb. The $6.60 red called a COMEX tariff artifact IS the LME cash price; red's $13,411/t 'Aug-26 forward' quote was stale or mislabelled. Re-file only with a mandatory 'pull the LME cash settlement series for the quoted date' step, and never with this evidence row.
kg_candidates.one_line: Narratives quoting COMEX-basis copper for a producer whose realisation is LME/European terms inflate implied economics by the tariff premium - but the check requires the LME CASH settlement for the exact quoted date, not a forward quote from an aggregator.
kg_candidates.fires_on: non-US producer plus a narrative metal price that differs from the LME cash settlement for the same date by more than ~2%
kg_candidates.evidence_here: BMM (NEGATIVE INSTANCE): red asserted an ~8% COMEX premium against a metalradar 'Aug-26 forward' of $13,411/t; westmetall LME cash for 14-Aug-2026 is $14,545/t, refuting the premium claim entirely.

kg_candidates.name: duplicate_bench_contradiction_unreconciled
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - a validator rule, not an analytical one, and it caught a live contradiction that would have propagated whichever blue artifact the adjudicator happened to open first.
kg_candidates.one_line: When a stage produces two artifacts for the same case (two reds, two blues), the queue must mark the case UNRECONCILED and the adjudicator must diff them - a duplicate bench that contradicts its twin on a checkable fact is a defect, not redundancy.
kg_candidates.fires_on: court_queue history contains two artifacts at the same stage for one ticker within a single court cycle
kg_candidates.evidence_here: BMM: COURT_BLUE at 01:00 and again at 01:03 on 2026-08-17. Blue-1 sustained red's COMEX-vs-LME basis finding (LME at $6.08/lb); blue-2 overturned it (LME cash $6.60/lb). Both cited the same red. ALBLD.PA has the mirror-image defect: two COURT_RED artifacts (01:06 and 01:08) of which blue adjudicated only one, leaving the second red's decisive Cint-comp finding untested.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED - Q2 interims filed 2026-08-13 (6-K 0001554855-26-001834), so a mid-November Q3 is cadence-consistent but no company PR names it. Tier B because the binding events on this name are NOT prints: they are the ESA step and the stream close, neither of which carries a scheduled date.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: At the print, read: (1) cash and the remaining initial-capex estimate against the US$184M FS number and the PP&E already in the ground (C$30.4M -> C$180.1M in H1, including a C$35.6M mineral-property reclass) - this is the only way to settle the financing-gap dispute the benches could not; (2) any stream terms or definitive agreement; (3) note on subsequent events and any ESA/MKE correspondence; (4) share count and any placement, against the value-ladder flow gate; (5) construction pace disclosures against a sentinel2 baseline if one has been taken by then.

branches.STREAM CLOSED >= US$80-100M ON <= 20% OF: financing leg resolved on non-destructive terms; re-court as a long sized to the stranded-capex tail, with ESA still open as the size governor.
branches.STREAM CLOSED CHEAP (LARGE PRECIOUS CARV: the appreciating leg has been sold at MOU-era terms; the spot-deck prize shrinks toward the consensus deck - reprice the whole file downward and do not treat the financing 'catalyst' as good news.
branches.EQUITY PLACEMENT INSTEAD OF STREAM: the predicted dilutive flow arrives; stand aside through it and re-price after, per the value-ladder gate.
branches.ESA REASONED OPINION AGAINST NORWAY WITH: stranded-capex tail is arriving; move to AVOID pending a cure path, and note blue's irreversibility clock - waiting is not free for the bull at ~C$25M/month of construction.
branches.ESA CLOSURE OR ROYAL DECREE WITH ARTICLE: the binary resolves for the bull; at LME cash near $6.60/lb the funded, cured prize is well above the tape - re-court immediately as a long.
